document.name: AFFCNY — NYC Caregiver Connection LIVE! Manhattan
document.description: AFFCNY publishes NYC Caregiver Connection LIVE! Manhattan as a free, in-person parent support group for adoptive, foster, or kinship families in New York City. The official event page says the group is generally scheduled for the second Saturday of each month from 1:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. at St John the Baptist, 213 W. 30th Street in Manhattan, and that youth hangouts run simultaneously so parents and kids can both get support. The page describes monthly discussions on children's behaviors, parental resilience, school challenges, social and emotional hurdles, and therapeutic versus traditional parenting approaches. Sources: https://affcny.org/nyc-caregiver/ https://affcny.org/events/nyc-caregiver-connection-live-manhattan/2026-03-14/
